description: List forms that belong to the authenticated organization. Requires an org API key with the forms:read scope. When a form is published and not soft-deleted, that item also includes publicUrl, publicFormUrl, embedUrl, and embedSnippet, and a draft that was never published omits those fields. A soft-deleted form omits those fields too.
name: list_forms

forms.description: Forms in this organization. The text block is this array as JSON.

embedSnippet.description: Script tag that embeds the form. Omitted when the form has never been published or is soft-deleted.

embedUrl.description: Iframe URL, /{org}/{form}?embed=1. Omitted when the form has never been published or is soft-deleted.

publicFormUrl.description: Canonical public form URL. Omitted when the form has never been published or is soft-deleted.

publicUrl.description: Same URL as publicFormUrl. Omitted when the form has never been published or is soft-deleted.

settings.description: Client settings JSON. Internal keys are omitted.

title: List forms
